core_obligations: The author constructs localized long-range eikonal modifiers across smooth spectral eigenprojections, proves radiation and commutator estimates, and closes both existence and completeness of the scattering operators without a global diagonalization.
difficulty_reason: The author constructs localized long-range eikonal modifiers across smooth spectral eigenprojections, proves radiation and commutator estimates, and closes both existence and completeness of the scattering operators without a global diagonalization.

dedup.scope: Current public909 counts only AHL235 Lemma5.2 (760-773), the prescribed-eikonal commutator expansion. This task counts the main existence/partial-isometry/completeness theorem (263-275) and retains the full local-to-global wave-operator proof; the existing commutator result is supporting context only.

compared.difference: A commutator expansion for given phases does not state existence or asymptotic completeness of the modified wave operators on spectral intervals.
